dispositions.reason: The established translation of 조장 in Taekyung’s squad is “Captain.”
The established term for 전서구 is “messenger pigeon.”
은원 includes both debts of gratitude and grudges, not two synonymous forms of hostility.
Black Mountain Blade remains the implied subject who would have suffered a worse fate.
Taekyung asks Han Yeop whether he will carry Gong Yacheong; Han Yeop then agrees.
The source describes Soyul’s softly audible breathing without indicating respiratory distress.
Hyuk Mujin’s established address for Taekyung is “Captain.”
기 싸움 denotes a battle of wills or intimidation here, not a literal clash of internal energy.
The source describes Jopil ripping Black Mountain Blade’s eyes open.
The established translation of 잠룡 is “Hidden Dragon.”

patches.new: The wandering martial artists thought it was fortunate that Black Mountain Blade was dead. If he had still been alive, he would have suffered something even more horrifying.

“Will you carry him?”

“Yes. I’ll carry him.”
Every time I heard her soft breathing, a pang of unease tightened in my chest.

patches.new: I couldn’t afford to lose the battle of wills, so I glared hard and lowered my voice.
patches.old: I couldn’t afford to lose a clash of qi, so I glared hard and dropped my voice.

patches.new: I ripped his eyes open before I left. Punishment for failing to recognize a master.
